prompt:
Design a striking premium engineering-team desktop wallpaper, 16:9 landscape 1920x1080, intended as an ORIGINAL FULL-CONTRAST BACKGROUND that will later have its opacity adjusted in a PMAC desktop motion control app. The previous design was rejected for being ugly, too faint and too pale. This replacement must have confident saturated colors, beautifully designed typography and much stronger visual identity. Do not pre-fade the artwork.

Art direction: black cherry, rich crimson red, charcoal black, pearl-white accents. A cinematic yet disciplined motorsport engineering visual identity: sharp, clean, premium, visually arresting. A smooth dark charcoal-black field occupies the left 55% and central areas so UI controls can later sit over it. Dramatic sculptural crimson ribbon surfaces and two thin glowing vermilion XY motion trajectory curves sweep diagonally along the outer right edge and bottom edge. These curves are elegant and precise, suggesting servo control and CNC tool paths, with one crisp small warm white control point. A few subtle technical grid lines ONLY in the lower right. Keep the image smooth, exceptionally composed and spacious. Strong reds must remain visibly red. No pastel colors, no blue or cyan, no watercolor or faint illustration.

IMPORTANT LAYOUT FOR LATER OFFICIAL LOGO COMPOSITING: reserve two calm clean spaces without marks or decoration: top-right rectangle x=64% to 94%, y=8% to 22%, and a large blank area x=75% to 90%, y=32% to 62%. These are reserved for a genuine official university logo and crest, which will be composited later. Do NOT invent, render, draw or imply any university crest, shield, owl, phoenix, animal, mascot, placeholder icon, circular medallion, badge or logo. Those reserved areas should remain a continuous smooth dark background that seamlessly belongs to the composition. Do not draw panels around them.

TEXT: in the lower right, place this EXACT Chinese team name in one line: "认清熬夜差距". Set it in a large sophisticated bold modern Chinese sans-serif typeface, clean even character shapes, beautifully spaced, pearl-white or warm ivory. The title spans from x=62% to 93%, y=72% to 80% (approximately). It should feel like a confident engineering-team wordmark. Immediately below, add exactly "汕头大学" in smaller warm white type, with restrained spacing. Exact characters, no missing or substituted characters. Add NO other text, English, numbers, slogan, labels, watermarks or signatures.

No photorealistic objects, no cartoon, no animal mascot, no giant moon, no stock technology collage, no dense circuitry, no busy dashboard graphics, no lens flare or starburst. This is a carefully art-directed flat graphic wallpaper with a few glossy abstract crimson surfaces and precise curves. Keep the broad left and central region quiet and visually coherent while giving the right and bottom strong personality. Crisp finish, outstanding design quality, high visual contrast in the original, not washed out.

Create a beautiful custom-designed wallpaper for a Shantou University engineering team called "认清熬夜差距", for a PMAC motion-control desktop app. Landscape 16:9 1920x1080. Generate the original at FULL CONTRAST with rich vivid color; the software will reduce its opacity later. The last attempt was rejected for being ugly and much too faint. This image must be confident, visually striking, polished and elegant.

Color art direction: deep saturated aubergine purple #28123D and royal purple #5C2A88, accented with luminous golden yellow #E9C552, warm amber and warm ivory. Absolutely no pale icy blue and no pale gray line illustration. Deep violet backgrounds and gold are a fresh rich color direction. Aim for a high-end university engineering society visual identity, contemporary refined graphic design with exquisite proportions.

Composition: a velvet-dark smooth purple background across the left 60% and the center, uninterrupted and calm to allow foreground interface controls later. In the lower band and at the far right edge, graceful wide matte-purple folded geometric ribbons and a few precise golden trajectories curve through space, mixing elegant parametric curves and one restrained concentric arc. Use a few smaller geometric precision markers to imply XY motion and engineering. Make the gold vivid enough to survive future software opacity adjustment, but avoid excessive glow. The visual should be mostly smooth sophisticated colored surfaces and confident geometry, not a collection of thin faded details. Two to three accents are enough; use them with taste. A subtle warm sunset-orange glint at the bottom right can enrich the palette.

Reserve clean uninterrupted purple spaces for authentic university logos to be placed AFTER generation: top-right x=64%-94%, y=8%-22%; and upper-right x=75%-90%, y=32%-62%. Leave these spaces EMPTY, part of the smooth purple field. Do not invent or draw any badge, emblem, crest, shield, phoenix, owl, moon, mascot, university logo, placeholder, ring or circle inside those spaces. There is no illustrated animal in this image.

Typography in the lower right: exact text "认清熬夜差距", one horizontal line, substantial but elegant premium modern Chinese type with medium-to-bold weight, warm light gold. Position within x=62%-93%, y=72%-80%; strong readable lettering, plenty of margins. Exact secondary line "汕头大学" beneath it in a smaller understated warm ivory modern Chinese sans-serif. Render every Chinese character correctly. Typography should be highly designed, aligned, legible and never distorted. Add no other words, Latin letters, numbers, slogans or watermarks.

This is a background graphic, not a screenshot, mockup or poster with cards. No UI controls, no photo collage, no generic cyberpunk circuit boards, no stars, no watercolor, no pale washed-out shading, no heavy textures, no overdesigned futuristic typography. Strong color, purposeful negative space, elegant curves, premium original full-contrast artwork.
